title: Public element sets against reconstructed orbits: a record-controlled reference benchmark
description: This version supersedes v1 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22656992). It corrects manoeuvre exclusions, horizon criteria and covariance coordinates, and adds the completed September calendar replay and topocentric comparison while retaining both learned-propagator negative findings. The benchmark contains 1,193 usable element sets on 15 spacecraft at 460-1,338 km. All four historical windows have been inspected; the September replay is a retrospective physical diagnostic. Results are descriptive for the stated populations, not operational guarantees. The storm term is reported separately and is outside the paper scope.
notes: Code is MIT licensed; third-party data retain their source terms. Measured MeerKAT beam data are CC BY-NC 4.0 and used for research only. Raw SpaceX ephemerides and ESA Kelvins inputs are not redistributed. The release provides the paper PDF, canonical evidence object, claims manifest, complete tables and publication-contract tests.
